card.name: Inside capitalized acronyms in parentheses
card.fires_on: The last letters of an all-caps acronym that is being spelled out, mostly TP (as in MTP, TTP) and similar endings like TC or TF, right after a full term and an opening parenthesis.

modes.label: Medical acronyms
modes.description: Closing letters TP of acronyms such as MTP or TTP after the full name is given.
modes.example: Microsomal triglyceride transfer protein (MT<<TP>>) inhibitors lomitapide

modes.label: Other acronyms and names
modes.description: Final letters of a non-medical acronym, or the middle of a personal name.
modes.example: Joint Terrorism Task Forces (JT<<TF>>s) are small cells

card.plain: It fires on the last letters of an abbreviation, such as TTP, when it is being defined in brackets.
